name: BeMedSearch
problem: Training doctors for high-stakes scenarios like post-labor hemorrhages requires more than static content; it demands a precise feedback loop. The challenge was to architect a platform capable of capturing every micro-interaction (clicks, hovers, and response times) while providing a flexible infrastructure for medical educators to build complex, multi-parameter simulations.
solution: Engineered a high-performance simulation engine using Vue.js and Firebase. I developed a custom Content Management System (CMS) from the ground up, allowing admins to define clinical parameters, medicine dosages, and logic-based surveys. The core architecture focuses on real-time event tracking, synchronizing every user action to a NoSQL database to generate detailed performance analytics and forensic review for medical practitioners.
result: A specialized medical training tool that transforms simulation into quantifiable data. The platform enables institutions to identify specific points of failure in clinical decision-making through millisecond-accurate tracking, hosted on a scalable, reactive infrastructure.

name: E-track
problem: Understanding the 'how' behind user navigation requires capturing high-frequency event data without compromising client-side performance. The challenge was to architect a low-latency pipeline capable of recording, processing, and reconstructing complex user sessions—including micro-movements and psychological triggers—into actionable visual intelligence.
solution: Engineered a high-performance analytics ecosystem featuring a lightweight, non-blocking JavaScript tracker for seamless site injection. The infrastructure utilizes a NestJS backend optimized for high-throughput data ingestion. I developed a visualization layer in Vue.js that renders sophisticated heatmaps, dynamic charts, and frame-accurate mouse movement simulations, effectively 'replaying' the user journey for deep psychological analysis.
result: A robust B2B tool that transforms raw interaction noise into strategic insights. The platform enables businesses to identify friction points and conversion bottlenecks through millisecond-precise telemetry, providing a scientific basis for UI/UX optimization and marketing research.

name: Ideias
problem: Creating a social platform for professionals requires more than just a feed; it requires tools that add tangible value to their contributions. The main challenge was implementing a server-side engine capable of generating custom-branded, paginated PDF documents on the fly, while maintaining a robust moderation pipeline to ensure the platform's intellectual integrity.
solution: Architected a high-performance web application using Nuxt.js to leverage Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for superior SEO and initial load speeds. I developed a specialized PDF Generation Microservice that automates branding and pagination for user-submitted works. Additionally, I built a centralized Administrative CMS that empowers moderators to review, edit, and approve content, ensuring a high-quality standard across the entire social graph.
result: A professional-grade social ecosystem where ideas are transformed into structured, shareable assets. The platform successfully bridges the gap between social interaction and professional publishing, providing users with automated tools to formalize their knowledge within a secure and moderated community.

name: Origins Films
problem: Transforming a traditional film showcase into a profitable, secure Video-on-Demand (VOD) platform for the Latin market. The challenge was to bridge the gap between high-quality streaming and secure monetization, ensuring that only paid users could access premium content while providing the owner with a robust administrative system to manage a growing catalog of movies and series.
solution: Developed a comprehensive VOD ecosystem using Vue.js for a cinematic user experience. I integrated the Vimeo API for secure, high-definition video delivery and implemented Stripe as the primary financial gateway for premium content. To automate the post-purchase flow, I engineered a system that generates and dispatches secure access credentials via email instantly upon transaction. Additionally, I built a custom Administrative Dashboard to streamline content uploads and catalog management, giving the client full control over their digital distribution.
result: A fully automated, revenue-generating platform that professionalizes Latin digital cinema distribution. By eliminating manual intervention in the sales-to-delivery funnel, the platform ensures 24/7 global accessibility for 'Origins', providing a secure and scalable infrastructure for independent filmmakers.

name: Nimvu
problem: Building a bespoke platform for a 3D-printed decor brand required a level of flexibility that standard e-commerce engines couldn't provide. After initially deploying with MedusaJs, the project hit significant architectural bottlenecks. The challenge was to migrate to a fully custom infrastructure that could handle localized payments in Colombia and provide a tailored administrative workflow for physical product manufacturing.
solution: Engineered a decoupled ecosystem consisting of three specialized applications. I architected a robust NestJS backend from scratch to replace the legacy system, providing full control over business logic and database schemas. The user-facing storefront was built in Next.js to optimize SEO and Core Web Vitals, while a dedicated React-based administrative dashboard was developed for real-time management of orders, categories, and inventory. For the financial layer, I implemented a seamless integration with Wompi to secure the Colombian market transaction flow.
result: A production-grade, scalable ecosystem with 99.9% uptime, hosted on a hybrid Vercel/Render infrastructure. The transition to a custom backend resulted in a more resilient API and a 100% bespoke admin experience, streamlining the path from digital order to physical 3D production.
